commands.description: Switch reasoning effort (CLI alias used by some Codex builds).

commands.description: Toggle Fast mode, or use on, off or status when the runtime advertises a Fast service tier.

notes: The app-server ignores slash text in turn input. Keep only commands xMatrix maps to an app-server request: /compact -> thread/compact/start, /review -> review/start.
